interpretation: Typed reading of the chapter's thesis (Ἅπαν τὸ κινούμενον ὑπό τινος ἀνάγκη κινεῖσθαι): whatever is being moved has some mover, in some respect. It is respect-free, like the source sentence: it does not say that the mover moves it in the respect in which it is moved (which the prima via's STMT-NOTHING-REDUCED-TO-ACT-EXCEPT-BY-A-MOVER says), and 'by something' is not 'by another'. The chapter's own proof (by cases on an internal source of motion, then dividing the per se mover) is not typed here; see docs/typed-physics.md.
